title: ze_halo3_the_storm
description:
This map has received a significant update since its initial release in 2025 (check change logs to see what is new). Server administrators are encouraged to retest the map for potential compatibility issues and bugs. Expect balancing and bug fix updates to come soon.

Experience Zombie Escape mixed with HALO in this map based on the 4th level from the HALO 3 campaign.

Map features:
- An unique shielding system that absorbs incoming damage and recharges over time (disabled in LASO difficulty).
- A faithfully recreated level for you to explore, fend off zombies and battle your way through to reach the end.
- A variety of covenant enemies featured in the HALO 3 campaign.
- 2 main boss fights.
- 3 demi-boss fights.
- 6 unique Human items (several with replenishable ammo).
- 2 unique Zombie items (each zombie item appears twice in the level for a total of 4 individual items).
- A cinematic ending cutscene (only for those who are able to conquer the challenging LASO difficulty).
- Several small easter eggs and secrets for you to discover.

Disclaimers and bug report:
- A few features of this map require CS2fixes to function properly; to fully experience this map it is recommended to play on a dedicated zombie escape server running the latest version of CS2fixes.
- Please report any bugs by leaving a comment in the pinned bug report thread.
- Feel free to leave feedback in the comments below.
- Map is considered 'Green' when the 'LASO' difficulty level has been completed.
